overview.description: The iShares MSCI USA Equal Weighted ETF (EUSA) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the MSCI USA Equal Weighted index. The fund tracks an equal-weighted index of US firms that covers 85% of the market capitalization of the equity market. EUSA was launched on May 5, 2010 and is issued by BlackRock.
